query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM (
            (SELECT * FROM place_dots_computed
             EXCEPT ALL
             SELECT z, tx, ty, kind, night, s, price, h, py, px, n FROM place_dots)
            UNION ALL
            (SELECT z, tx, ty, kind, night, s, price, h, py, px, n FROM place_dots
             EXCEPT ALL
             SELECT * FROM place_dots_computed)
        ) d
